Added 23 recent papers (2025–2026) in new "Recent Papers" subsection. File now 58 papers total.

Highlights of new batch:
- **Fresh recipes**: IMU-1 (2026 sample-efficient SLM cookbook), Nemotron-Flash (hybrid SSM/attention SLM), daVinci-LLM (pretraining sets capability ceiling)
- **On-policy distillation wave**: mechanism paper showing student can surpass teacher, OPD survey (production use in Qwen3/DeepSeek-V4/Gemma 2), self-distillation without big teacher
- **Tiny recursion**: Probabilistic Tiny Recursive Model, Tiny Autoregressive Recursive Models, LoopFormer — strongest current line for tiny-but-smart
- **Reasoning compression**: Compress-Distill (96% accuracy at 18x token efficiency), 73% CoT cut with accuracy gain — how to fit reasoning into small student
- **Capacity science**: distillation halves memorization, MLP value vectors as knowledge units, diffusion LMs as super data learners, latent-prediction sample-complexity theory

Sources: [IMU-1](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2602.02522), [Nemotron-Flash](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2511.18890), [Rethinking OPD](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.13016), [OPD Survey](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2604.00626), [Self-Distilled Reasoner](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2601.18734), [PTRM](https://arxiv.org/html/2605.19943v1), [Tiny AR Recursive](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2603.08082), [daVinci-LLM](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.27164), [Procedural Pretraining](https://arxiv.org/html/2601.21725v2), [Output Embedding Centering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.02031), [Compress-Distill](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05988), [Mixed-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.08776), [Extra-CoT](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.08324), [Hourglass FFN](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2602.06471), [Memorization in KD](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.15394), [Parameter Specialization](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2505.17260), [Diffusion Super Data Learners](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2510.04071), [Latent Sample-Complexity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27734), [µP Small Models](https://arxiv.org/html/2602.10545v1), [JustRL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.16649), [Pedagogical Data Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2602.12172), [LoopFormer](https://arxiv.org/html/2602.11451v1), [SLMs Pack a Punch](https://arxiv.org/html/2501.05465v2)
